skip.about: Plays that cannot pass in a gate project, by story file and name: a mouse-only assertion on the touch phone, a token colour asserted in forced colours.

touch.DropdownMenu.stories.tsx::Scrolling: The play asserts the scroll arrows, which show only to a hover pointer; on a touch phone the list scrolls natively.
touch.Scroller.stories.tsx::Horizontal: The play asserts the scroll arrows, which show only to a hover pointer; on a touch phone the list scrolls natively.
touch.Scroller.stories.tsx::Vertical: The play asserts the scroll arrows, which show only to a hover pointer; on a touch phone the list scrolls natively.
touch.Tabs.stories.tsx::Responsive Widths: The play asserts the scroll arrows, which show only to a hover pointer; on a touch phone the list scrolls natively.
touch.DataTable.stories.tsx::Column width from: The play asserts column widths measured with a fine pointer; on touch the row actions show without hover and the table reserves their width.
touch.DataTable.stories.tsx::Stored Views Matr: The play asserts column widths measured with a fine pointer; on touch the row actions show without hover and the table reserves their width.
touch.Grid.stories.tsx::Dont: The Don't overflows the page on purpose (layout-allow.json exempts it at 390px).
touch.IconButton.stories.tsx::In A Dense Row: Kit bug: on a touch phone the last button's 24px hit area (touch-target ::before) reaches 2px past the 390px page, so the page scrolls sideways. Remove the entry when IconButton keeps its hit area inside the row.

forced-colors.Stat.stories.tsx::Frames: The play asserts a token colour, which forced colours replace with a system colour.
forced-colors.Pages.stories.tsx::Record: The play asserts that the rail and the page differ in fill, which forced colours make one Canvas.
forced-colors.Mode.stories.tsx::Increased Contrast: The play measures contrast between tokens, which forced colours replace with system colours.
forced-colors.Color.stories.tsx::Increased Contrast: The play measures contrast between tokens, which forced colours replace with system colours.

focus.about: Stories whose focus stops lost half or more of their ring when the gate landed (audit G3). The number is how many stops may; fix the part and lower it.

touch.about: Stories with controls under 24px or shown only on hover on a touch phone when the gate landed (audit TOO-8, TOO-9, responsive-2026-09-24 #10).

forced-colors.about: Stories whose selected, pressed, current or checked items looked like their siblings in forced colours when the gate landed (audit TOO-7, STR-9).

short.about: Overlay stories with controls out of view when focused, or a title nothing scrolls to, at 320x256 when the gate landed (audit G5).

long.about: Stories that scrolled the page, painted past the frame or cut text without an ellipsis once their text grew when the gate landed (audit G1-12).
